analyst_view.overall: Early view: the return of the game Barcelona won 2-1 at the Metropolitano on 8 November, brought forward from February because of the Supercopa. It sits between Barça's trip to Deportivo and the visit of Manchester City on 8 December, while Atlético host Viking on 25 November; Simeone said his side lacked a cutting edge in the first meeting and Julián Álvarez missed clear chances.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.6 goals. Atlético have conceded only 10 in 12, the first meeting finished 2-1 with just 8 shots on target between the teams, and Simeone's side defend deep away from home. I lean lower, around 3.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners. The first meeting produced only 6 (Atlético 4, Barça 2) and Barcelona's home win over Alavés also had 6; Barça work the ball inside rather than forcing corners. I lean lower, around 8.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.7 cards. Atlético took four yellows in the first meeting (Baena, Llorente, Pubill and Hjulmand) against Barça's one, and Baena and Pubill are one booking from bans, which may restrain them a little. The rivalry supports a busy card count, so I stay around 5-6.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.7 shots, almost exactly the 19-9 split from the first meeting. Barcelona will have the ball again and Atlético will look to break, so I see no reason to move off it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 on target. The first meeting had only 8 on target (4 each) from 28 shots, Atlético block a lot in their own box, and Julián Álvarez has been off target lately. I lean lower, around 7-8.
